text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Congratulations! Chee~rs! A toast, de~su!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks everyone for gathering! Receiving 
this wonderful honor was all thanks to 
Papa, Mama, my friends... and of course—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The great director who gave me the offer 
to appear in this Western movie!

text_block_list.name: Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! N-No way! Calling me a "great 
director"! I'm still just a student 
learning the ropes, so um...

text_block_list.name: Passing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? Does that mean Taiki-san was 
in a movie and won an award?! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Everyone in the back, you are welcome 
to drop in and join the party too! 
There'll be lots of events, you know~♪
choice_data_list: Wait, are you sure it's alright...?
Wait, are you sure it's alright...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Let's all party and get 
feverish together! First off—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: BBQ & dancing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The "Make the meat tastier" dance! Rare♪ 
Medium♪ Well-do~ne♪ Whoooo~~~!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... M-Make it tastier! Make it 
tastier...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next number is— Number 18, desu! 
Do we have any Bingo winners out there?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Congratula~tions! Time to award a 
magnificent prize! Which means—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I will give you an autograph from me and 
the director!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
An autograph?! B-But is someone like me 
really good enough for that...?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the party's wrapping up! When 
talking about the finale, there can only 
be one thing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woooow! Fantastic! So beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today, everyone! It 
was a super fun party!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now I feel pumped up and excited to do my 
best for the shooting starting up!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, good luck with filming—... Wait, 
what?

Yeah, good luck with filming—... Wait, 
what?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh? What's the matter?
choice_data_list:
This party was to celebrate winning a 
movie award... right?

This party was to celebrate winning a 
movie award... right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Award? Oh, you are very hasty! Filming 
starts from now on, desu!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Forget filming, we're still in the 
middle of gathering staff...!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
...So, as I was saying, I'm producing a 
movie for the "Student Film Festival." 
When I was worrying over who to ask to 
play the lead role—

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
I saw Taiki-san shining on the racetrack. 
On such a grand stage... far from 
shrinking back, she ran with such a 
fierce, joyous smile.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
It matched my image of the protagonist 
perfectly. I offered her the role right on 
the spot!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-san agreed immediately, and we 
discussed getting things moving right 
away! Just when I thought we'd prepare for 
shooting—
choice_data_list: It turned into preparing for a party...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because I was so very happy, desu! If so, 
having a party is the only choice!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm thinking about other things 
too, you know? To gather staff—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A cast scouting party and a shooting 
location decision party are an absolute 
must!
choice_data_list: You're going to throw MORE parties?!
You're going to throw MORE parties?!

text_block_list.text:
In her own unique way, Taiki Shuttle was 
showing full motivation for starring in 
the movie...
